::: {.callout-important icon="false"}
## Fatima's impressions

- Lockless room!
- Most puzzles were quite straightforward
- One puzzle required quite a bit of precision and there was no special sound for resetting, so it was a little difficult to know if we are on track or not
- Overall, even though the quality was quite ok, it still felt a little underwhelming.
:::

```{r}
library(leaflet)

meta <- tryCatch(rmarkdown::metadata, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(meta) && !is.null(meta$long) && !is.null(meta$lat)) {
  leaflet() %>% 
    addTiles() %>% 
    addProviderTiles('Esri.WorldGrayCanvas') %>% 
    addMarkers(lng = meta$long, lat = meta$lat)
}
```
